item.title: How politics in Minneapolis are putting law enforcement at risk
item.description: Minneapolis offers a warning for law enforcement leaders as political conflict undermines coordination and officer safety

item.title: Shots Fired: Federal agents shooting Alex Pretti in Minneapolis
item.description: How crowd dynamics, officer training and real-time decisions shaped the narrative before the investigation began

item.title: N.J. law protects police officers from retaliation after PTSD leave
item.description: The new statute bars employers from disciplining police officers and other paid first responders who seek treatment and requires reinstatement once they are cleared to return to duty

item.title: Man shot after exchanging gunfire with Border Patrol agents near US-Mexico border
item.description: Federal agents were attempting to apprehend the 34-year-old Arizona man during a traffic stop near Arivaca, Arizona, when he fled and shot at a Border Patrol helicopter and at agents

item.title: Boston Police ignored all 57 immigration detainer requests from ICE last year, commissioner says
item.description: Commissioner Michael Cox attributed the police department’s non-compliance to the Boston Trust Act, which prohibits BPD from cooperating with ICE on civil immigration detainers

item.title: Outgoing Va. governor pardons former police officer who was convicted in fatal OIS
item.description: Former Fairfax County Sgt. Wesley Shifflett was convicted of reckless handling of a firearm, but an independent auditor's review found his use of deadly force justified

item.title: Calif. bill would ban current ICE employees from LE, teacher jobs
item.description: Assembly Bill 1627 would prohibit ICE officers from serving in any California state or local police agency or working as teachers, administrators or staff in public schools
